fact: The 2025 report states the NCI-CRVS digital system registers births and deaths at all five categories of registration offices, the paper system has been entirely phased out, and birth registration completeness rose from 90.3% in 2024 to 92.9% in 2025.
title: RwandaVITAL: Rwanda Vital Statistics Report 2025
publisher: National Institute of Statistics of Rwanda
